system.name: VCD (Visual Commonsense Dataset)
system.one_liner: A dataset of 100,000+ images with 14M object-grounded commonsense triples, organised by a Seen/Unseen and Property/Action/Space taxonomy.

content.variant_note: one annotated street photo and two stacked object cards (man, car), each listing Seen and Unseen triples by Property, Space, Action with a highlighted explanation sentence
content.argues: Each object in an image carries both directly observable (Seen) and inferable (Unseen) commonsense triples, grouped by aspect, grounded to its box and explained in a sentence.
content.subject: a street photo with two boxed objects, each with Seen and Unseen commonsense triples and an explanation sentence

lessons.what_to_learn: Show a dataset's taxonomy on one real record: box the objects in the photo, pull each out with an arrow, nest the labels with curly braces and give each category one text colour, then close with a highlighted sentence that verbalises one entry.

evidence: ( man, ReceivesAction, hit by a car) is an Unseen commonsense under the Action aspect.
These triples are organized within a hierarchical taxonomy.
we introduce a visibility dimension that classifies knowledge as seen or unseen commonsense

summary: VCD is a dataset of over 100,000 images and 14 million object-commonsense pairs that adds visually grounded commonsense to scene-graph data, organised by a three-level taxonomy: visibility (Seen or Unseen), aspect (Property, Action, Space) and relation type. Figure 1 shows one record. A street photo has a man and a car boxed with dashed white rectangles, and gold elbow arrows pull each out as a thumbnail. Beside each thumbnail, curly braces nest a Seen group (detective emoji) and an Unseen group (thinking-face emoji), each split into Property, Space and Action, with relation names coloured by aspect and a tiny object crop before every triple. A dashed fan opens the last Unseen triple into an explanation sentence with highlighted head, relation and tail.
summary_zh: VCD 是带视觉常识三元组的图像数据集。图一用一张街景作示例：框出人和车，用金色箭头引出缩略图，再按看得见与看不见、属性、空间、动作分组列出三元组，并配一句高亮的解释。
notes: Prior labels kept (scope-overview, worked-walkthrough) with concept-schematic added; the figure is a single annotated record rather than a gallery of framed cards, so panels is empty. The caption says 11 triples but the drawing lists 17 (8 for the man, 9 for the car) with ellipses. The meaning of the green, yellow and light-blue highlights is inferred from where they fall (head, relation, tail); the figure has no key. Text colours were read from the SVG text fills.
